model: For each 5/20-day residual target fit fixed regression anchor, positive-direction probability and top-20-percent tail probability on an 8-year mature-label window.
Replace only the original LightGBM contribution with a fixed 50/50 direction/tail probability blend; retain frozen V6/Ridge contributions and 0.3/0.7 horizon weights.
Use two strictly prior validation years to assign active confidence in {0,0.25,0.5,1}; scale only the 15% maximum active budget by confidence.

drawdown_change: Absolute strategy drawdown is reported but no longer a V28 promotion gate. Active drawdown is the drawdown of cumulative strategy wealth divided by cumulative benchmark wealth, sampled at frozen settlement dates.
